summary: Verified end-to-end Marketing & Affiliate flow. Backend: 18/18 pytest passing (test_marketing_affiliate.py) covering merchant campaign creation (ad+affiliate), targeting filter (city+gender), view/click tracking counters increment on merchant list, affiliate application (dedup blocks duplicate pending with 400, auto-fills applicant_phone/city/email from user account), approve returns 10-char referral_code and commission_percent pulled from linked campaign (10%), idempotent approve returns 400, GET /affiliate/dashboard returns all required fields (commission_percent, referral_code, total_earnings, total_clicks, total_conversions, unique_visitors, incentives, this_month_earnings), GET /affiliate/my mirrors, public POST /affiliate/{code}/click (no auth) increments total_clicks and 404s on invalid code. Frontend (Playwright 390x844): Merchant login → /merchant/marketing shows empty state 'لا توجد إعلانات', top-right + opens picker with both 'إعلان مستهدف مجاني' and 'برنامج مسوّقين بالعمولة', tapping affiliate opens form with title/commission pills (2/5/10/15/20)/incentives/image picker/cities chips/gender pills/interest tags/date range, filling title='TEST_ انضم لبرنامج مسوّقي زايتكس' + 10% + incentives 'أفضل مسوق شهرياً' + tapping نشر gold button creates the campaign — appears under 'المسوقون' → '💎 برامج التسويق بالعمولة (1)' with 10% badge. Customer login → Social tab shows gold-bordered campaign card at top with '🎁 10% عمولة' badge, merchant name 'Zitex Store', title, '🎯 أفضل مسوق شهرياً' incentives, and 'قدّم الآن' gold CTA. Tap CTA → navigates to /affiliate-apply?merchant_id=…&campaign_id=…&commission=10 with hero 'اربح 10% عمولة', 'التقديم لـ: Zitex Store', green auto-fill badge 'المعلومات مأخوذة من حسابك تلقائياً', name/phone/city prefilled from account (0500000000 / الرياض / مستخدم تجريبي), social+audience empty (as designed). Filling social=@test_affiliate & audience=5000 + submit → application created (verified via GET /merchant/affiliate/applications: applicant_phone=0500000000, applicant_city=الرياض, social_handle=@test_affiliate, audience_size=5000, status=pending). After approve → customer home shows [🛍 المتجر  |  🏆 المسوّق 1] pill toggle with badge='1'; tapping 🏆 المسوّق → /my-affiliate displays 'لوحة المسوّق', gold hero '10%' + 'تاجر: Zitex Store', referral link box https://<host>/r/P8WFDY0M3T with نسخ/مشاركة/واتساب buttons, code chip P8WFDY0M3T, analytics grid (0 نقرة / 0 زائر فريد / 0 تحويل), this-month + total-earnings gold-bordered cards, wallet card 0.00 ر.س + سحب button, '🎁 الحوافز أفضل مسوق شهرياً', and '📋 أحدث التحويلات' empty state. Only caveats: (1) Alert.alert('OK') native-style success dialogs are RN-Web-rendered as blocking overlays that Playwright's page.on('dialog') cannot intercept — the underlying network calls DO succeed but the on-screen confirmation and post-submit navigation are gated behind the alert; (2) merchant-marketing/affiliate-apply/my-affiliate screens had NO testIDs on any interactive elements — added minimum testIDs (marketing-add-btn, picker-ad, picker-affiliate, form-title-input, form-incentives-input, form-submit-btn, apply-social-input, apply-audience-input, apply-submit-btn) to enable automation. Deprecated packages detected: none new. React Native SVG/Ionicons and expo-router all render correctly. Console warnings unchanged from prior session: 'shadow*' style props deprecated, Image.resizeMode deprecated, props.pointerEvents deprecated — these are RN-Web-only informational warnings originating from third-party libs, not blocking.

ui_bugs.component: Alert.alert usage in marketing.tsx (submit, approve, reject) and affiliate-apply.tsx (submit)
ui_bugs.issue: Success/confirm dialogs use React Native's Alert.alert which renders as a blocking JS overlay on RN-Web. This works for end-users but breaks automation: page.on('dialog') does not catch it, and the merchant approve confirmation stays open until user manually taps OK, blocking subsequent navigation. Consider replacing with a custom in-app modal (with testID) or auto-dismiss toast so both UX and E2E flows are deterministic.

issues: Picker options and form fields lacked testID attributes — required manual addition to run automation. Recommend adding testIDs on ALL new interactive components going forward: TouchableOpacity/Pressable, TextInput, Modal actions.
Submit button and inputs lacked testIDs — added by testing agent.
No testIDs on 'نسخ'/'مشاركة'/'واتساب' buttons or 'سحب' button — visual review OK but automation and future regression testing will need them.

action_items: OPTIONAL (Frontend, LOW): Add testID to remaining interactive elements in /app/frontend/app/merchant/marketing.tsx (approve/reject buttons, city chips, gender pills, tag chips, image picker), /app/frontend/app/affiliate-apply.tsx (name/city inputs), and /app/frontend/app/my-affiliate.tsx (نسخ/مشاركة/واتساب/سحب buttons) — 8 more elements. Testing agent added the minimum required (9 testIDs) to make E2E automation possible.

OPTIONAL (Frontend, LOW): Consider replacing Alert.alert on success with an in-app toast/modal (with testID='success-toast') so post-submit navigation is not gated behind a native alert — will make future E2E deterministic without page.on('dialog') work-arounds.
NO CHANGES NEEDED (Backend): all 18 tests green — endpoints match spec exactly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend approve endpoint (server.py:3266-3319) correctly pulls commission from the linked marketing_ads campaign when campaign_id is present, defaulting to 5% otherwise. Referral code generation uses secrets.token_urlsafe(8) → strips _/- → uppercase → truncates to 10 chars, with a uniqueness while-loop over db.affiliates. Good.

Backend /marketing/ads/active (server.py:3178-3204) applies targeting AFTER a MongoDB query on active=true — for large ad volumes, consider pushing target_cities/$in and target_genders/$in into the query for performance. Currently N campaigns → all fetched then filtered in Python.

Backend /affiliate/apply (server.py:3225-3256) correctly auto-includes applicant_phone, applicant_city, applicant_email from user account. Missing audit: no length/regex validation on social_handle (empty string allowed, could be arbitrary text) — low priority.

Backend /marketing/ads/{aid}/track (server.py:3206-3214) has no rate limiting — a single user could inflate views/clicks by looping. For production, consider deduping by (user_id + ad_id + event) per session or per day.
Frontend /app/frontend/app/merchant/marketing.tsx is 557 lines — approaches the 700-line threshold. Extracting the form modal into a MarketingAdForm component would improve maintainability.
Frontend /app/frontend/app/affiliate-apply.tsx submit button relies on Alert.alert for both error and success feedback; on RN-Web this blocks E2E tests. Suggest custom toast (see action_items).
Frontend /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/social.tsx correctly wraps campaigns.map in an array; each card has activeOpacity=0.9 and dispatches track?event=click on tap — good UX pattern.

rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs to root-cause. Only minor observation: Alert.alert on RN-Web produces a JS-blocking overlay that Playwright's dialog handler cannot catch. This does NOT affect end users, only automated E2E tests. Mitigation: replace Alert.alert with custom modals/toasts that have testIDs, or in automation call the underlying API directly after tapping submit.
